title: Braided Silhouettes
description: Three overlapping female profiles with closed eyes and intricate braided hairstyles rendered in white, pink, and black lines against a dark background. The largest figure features elaborate white braids adorned with golden chains and circular patterns, while smaller pink and white profiles appear below, surrounded by glowing orbs containing silhouetted figures on hills, scarab beetles, and floating bubbles.
